content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a switch converter that transforms decimal values into binary signals. I want to connect the resulting binary output signals—four from the units, and eight additional from tens and hundreds—to twelve inputs on [product_name]. My intention is to select a value on the switch, for example 150, and use that value as the setpoint for a countdown counter. Is there an existing program or functionality in [product_name] software for this purpose, or a converter from binary to decimal?
You may want to give this a try.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is searching for an integrated solution to convert binary inputs from hardware into decimal values with [product_name], aiming to use these as setpoints for a countdown counter. The post shows uncertainty about whether such a feature or pre-built program exists within [product_name] software, suggesting possible gaps in guidance or documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to find a ready-made program or built-in binary-to-decimal conversion feature in [product_name] software, preferably one that also allows these values to be used as counter inputs.
